notes: All profiles homogeneous; the legal-move safeguard from the balance study remains.
Ownership rotations remap initial home owners/founders while keeping player IDs, decks and initial actor fixed.
Starter rotations move the initial shuffled six-card decks between identities before any draw.
Home palette intervention changes only home resource types; geometry and AI are unchanged.
Shipyard interventions change only the first successful Shipyard preference, not costs or subsequent building priorities.
Every intervention shares map seed and RNG initialization with its baseline.
